decisions.statement: A finding is named by the slug that finding is filed under.
A name that is no finding is refused.
A call naming other than one word is refused.
A name of no text is refused.
Where the finding's page sits is read from the index rather than composed.
Taking the page away is left to the mechanical change taking a page away.
A run says the commit that run landed.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.
A change that refused is a fault of the data.
Nothing here asks Alan to confirm.
No check runs over the change a run lands.
A run that wrote before it threw says in its refusal what that run had written.

definition: the command taking one finding's page away with the files beside that page
